question: Propranolol is a first-line preventive agent for migraine and should be considered when attacks occur ≥4 days per month causing significant disability.

l10n.wrongAnswerMessage: This statement is TRUE. Both propranolol (a beta-blocker) and topiramate (an antiepileptic) are guideline-endorsed first-line migraine preventives. The ≥4 days/month threshold is the commonly used indication for initiating preventive therapy.
l10n.correctAnswerMessage: Correct. Propranolol (and topiramate) are established first-line migraine preventives. Preventive therapy is indicated when attacks occur ≥4 days/month with disability, when acute therapy is overused, or when attacks are severely debilitating.
